marketing.claim_text.value:
Made with Akesson’s Organic Estate Madagascar Milk 58%, crafted from cocoa grown on a single farm in Madagascar, these chocolate baking drops bring the character of their origin into your kitchen.
We have been baking with our chocolate since we started making it in 2013, and we are pleased to present it in a format that is easy to use at home. These tins contain the same chocolate pastilles used by professional chefs and bakers.
Each oval weighs approximately 5g, making them a convenient format for melting into batters, ganaches and sauces. Alternatively, break them into cookie doughs, melt and glaze over cakes, or simply enjoy as a snack.
Tempered and ready to use, they are an easy way to bake with exceptional single-farm chocolate from Madagascar.
You discover more from our Madagascar Collection here
Bean to bar chocolate homemade in Suffolk, UK.
225g

marketing.claim_text.value:
This is the second bar in our Double Origin Series and also an addition to our Bakery Series. The bar unites the mildly spiced, sweet Haiti 60% chocolate with two inclusions. Firstly the nutty, creamy crunch of caramelised organic British walnuts sourced from Sharpham Park in Somerset followed by the rich, decadent brownie pieces from our Bakery in Suffolk.
Continuing on the range from our Madagascar and Sea Salt 55% bar, the wrap is illustrated by Suffolk based artist Annabel Pearl. For this bar she sought inspiration from Georgian botanical illustrations, depicting walnuts with their branches and leaves.
You can discover more from our Bakery Series here.

We have spent years perfecting our traditional Panettone in the bakery. It is rich, perfumed, full of candied fruit and topped with almonds and sugar crystals, and those flavours are all represented in this chocolate bar. Dark chocolate made with Grenadian cocoa beans from Crayfish Bay Organic Estate, is enriched with our own panettone, then orange peel and nibs of toasted almond and sugar are embedded in the bar.
Perfect for anyone who loves panettone or other richly flavoured Christmas cakes. Also available as a mini bar.
You can discover more from our Bakery Series.

marketing.claim_text.value:
Our mini bars represent the evolution of our bar format. Whereas the 70g bars are made to be tasted, enjoyed and savoured over several sittings, the mini bars are crafted to be enjoyed as a single portion. Simply tear open and savour. Enjoy with a morning coffee or as an after dinner treat.
We have spent years perfecting our traditional Panettone in the bakery.  It is rich, perfumed, full of candied fruit and topped with almonds and sugar crystals, and those flavours are all represented in this chocolate bar. Dark chocolate made with Grenadan cocoa beans from Crayfish Bay Organic Estate, is enriched with our own panettone, then orange peel and nibs of toasted almond and sugar are embedded in the bar.
Perfect for anyone who loves panettone or other richly flavoured Christmas cakes. Also available as a larger bar.
You can discover more from our Bakery Series.
Bean to bar chocolate handmade in Suffolk, UK.
